name: crm-notifications
title: Company notifications
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Header popover of company notices with an unread count, mark read, and mark all read.

meta.descriptionEs: Popover de cabecera con avisos de empresas, un conteo de no leídos y marcar como leído.

examples.title: Avisos
examples.description: Cuatro avisos ficticios. Dos siguen sin leer.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, veinte avisos y un título sin espacios.

api.name: items / defaultItems
api.description: Pass items to control read state. defaultItems keeps it inside the popover.

api.name: onSelect
api.description: Fires when a row is chosen, after that row is marked read.

api.name: labels
api.description: Trigger, empty state, and mark-all. The unread count is part of the trigger name.

docs: Clean-room behavior inspired by github.com/kargulstudio/sales-crm, which publishes no license. No source, class names, colors, copy, or assets were copied. notification-center is the grouped inbox with read state. notification-stack is the depth stack. This popover is the short company list. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button or popover. The item ships no theme. Arrow keys move between notices. It does not animate.
